title: Some new results on determinants and permanents
summary: In this paper we confirm several conjectures on determinants and permanents. For example, we prove that for any prime $p\equiv3\pmod 4$ the number $2\det[a_{jk}]_{0\le j,k\le (p-1)/2}$ is congruent to a square modulo $p$, where $a_{jk}=(\frac{j+k}{p})+(\frac{j^2+k^2}{p})$ with $(\frac{\cdot}{p})$ the Legendre symbol. We also prove that ${\rm per}[j^{k-1}]_{1\leq j,k\leq n-1}\equiv0\pmod n$ for any integer $n>1$ with $n\not\equiv2\pmod 4$.
